Question ID: ANP_U05_L01_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.CRI.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Blood Composition and Formed Elements
Stimulus: Blood composition stimulus

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, separate plasma from formed elements. Then use the required stimulus (Blood composition stimulus) to connect the visible evidence to blood composition and formed elements. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.CRI.01 and avoids the common mistake: thinking blood is only red blood cells.
